description: Edge SRE view of the Envoy Gateway install: golden signals on the data plane (job=envoy-gateway), control-plane health (job=envoy-gateway-controller), and process-level infrastructure.

spec.title: README — how to read this dashboard

options.content:
**Control plane says** “traffic to `/payment` must go THERE, with THIS timeout and THIS TLS.” · **Data plane says** “OK — a `/payment` request just passed through me in 120 ms.” · **This dashboard says** “20k req/s, p99 is 1.2 s, and 5xx is rising.”

**What each row reads:** **Edge Overview** + **Data Plane** ← job `envoy-gateway` (Envoy proxy stats, gateway:19005 `/stats/prometheus`) · **Control Plane** ← job `envoy-gateway-controller` (EG controller, gateway:19001) · **Infrastructure** ← process/server metrics from both jobs.

Panels reading kube-state / cAdvisor metrics only exist on the Kubernetes cluster — they are empty locally by design; the affected panel carries a live local fallback query alongside them.
